TEXT BUILDER · SIMPLE STATEMENTS WITH BE

Small sentences. Clear meaning.

A simple statement with be has this pattern:

subject+verb+complement

What does each part do?

Subject: who or what the sentence is about.
Verb: a form of be: am, is or are.
Complement: information about the subject, such as a name, nationality, age, feeling or place.

My classmates are really friendly.

Contractions: I’m = I am · he’s/she’s/it’s = he/she/it is · we’re/they’re = we/they are.

SPEAKING · EXERCISE 7

Tell your partner about a sport you love.

Choose a sport. Use simple statements with be. Speak, listen, then swap roles.

Your speaking frame

I love …
It’s really …
My favorite team/player is …
The players are …
I’m happy when …

Choose your own ideas. You do not need to type anything.

A short model

I love soccer. It’s really exciting! My favorite team is my university team. The players are fast and friendly. I’m happy when we play together.

Questions to keep talking

What is your favorite sport?
Who is your favorite player?
Is your team good?
Why do you love this sport?
